summary: Brain Age entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Brain Age: Train Your Brain in Minutes a Day!
entries.definitive_edition: Original Nintendo DS cartridge on native hardware

emulation.emulator: melonDS or DeSmuME only for preservation comparison
emulation.notes: Native DS hardware is preferred because touch/microphone and daily-use ergonomics matter.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original DS hardware with calibrated touch screen, microphone, and real calendar state

primary.version: Original DS cartridge on native hardware
primary.why: Brain Age depends on Nintendo DS touch-screen handwriting, microphone recognition, book-style rotation, and daily-calendar save behavior. Native DS hardware with the original cartridge is the fidelity route; later Brain Age/Brain Training entries are separate games.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Nintendo DS/DS Lite/DSi with the original cartridge. Record region/title variant, hardware model, handedness setting, microphone/touch calibration, date/calendar state, Sudoku inclusion, daily-training unlock state, and whether Wii U Virtual Console or Switch Brain Training was only referenced.

secondary.exclusive_content: Historical digital re-release route in limited regions
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if already owned and documenting re-release behavior.
secondary.why: Original DS hardware best preserves the intended touch/mic posture and calendar feel.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute Brain Age 2, DSiWare Express releases, or Dr Kawashima's Brain Training for Nintendo Switch.
